corrections_recorded_in_this_round.item: 3. Token extraction defect in the application's section 3.3
corrections_recorded_in_this_round.text: The value of EVENTKIT_BRIDGE_BEARER_TOKEN in bridge.env is wrapped in double quotes. The documented extraction produced 66 bytes including the quotes, which failed authentication (401 instead of 403) on the first preflight. The extraction must strip the surrounding quotes; the corrected value is 65 bytes including the trailing newline. This was a defect in the written procedure, not in the bridge, and it is recorded here rather than silently fixed.
